# ESP-IDF 6.0.1 needs the later bundle fixes before enabling cross-signed roots.
# Replace this source in the build; leave the shared PlatformIO package intact.
if(NOT CONFIG_MBEDTLS_CERTIFICATE_BUNDLE)
    return()
endif()

idf_component_get_property(bundle_library mbedtls COMPONENT_LIB)
idf_component_get_property(mbedtls_directory mbedtls COMPONENT_DIR)
set(original_bundle "${mbedtls_directory}/esp_crt_bundle/esp_crt_bundle.c")
file(READ "${original_bundle}" original_source)
string(REPLACE "\r\n" "\n" original_source "${original_source}")
string(SHA256 original_hash "${original_source}")
if(NOT original_hash STREQUAL "e44d1e0a42a9d33cfc072ea005e93c8a0337c5ebcbfb9a1cf1554930f4f2816f")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ESP-IDF certificate bundle changed; review or remove the 6.0.3 backport")
endif()

get_target_property(bundle_sources ${bundle_library} SOURCES)
set(replaced_sources 0)
foreach(source IN LISTS bundle_sources)
    if(source MATCHES "(^|/)esp_crt_bundle/esp_crt_bundle\\.c$")
        list(REMOVE_ITEM bundle_sources "${source}")
        math(EXPR replaced_sources "${replaced_sources} + 1")
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT replaced_sources EQUAL 1)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Expected one ESP-IDF certificate bundle source")
endif()
set_property(TARGET ${bundle_library} PROPERTY SOURCES "${bundle_sources}")
target_sources(${bundle_library} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/esp_crt_bundle.c")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${original_bundle}")
